newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Group to sell stake in unit.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Group to sell stake in unit.

text.p: Malaysian conglomerate Berjaya Group Bhd said it planned to sell an 80 percent stake in its subsidiary Berjaya Singer Bhd
The sale at a value of 1.196 billion ringgit would result in an exceptional gain of 417.1 million ringgit for the group, the company said in a statement.
However, the sale is conditional on Berjaya Group able to buy back all of Berjaya Singer's subsidiary companies for around 1.317 billion ringgit.
Berjaya Group only described the acquirer as a "third party".
The subsidiaries of diversified Berjaya Singer are Singer (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd, Cosway (M) Sdn Bhd, Dunham-Bush (Malaysia) Bhd AND Unza Holdings Bhd.

The third party would be left with a shell company, into which it would have to inject "viable assets to ensure the future income stream of the company," as one of the conditions of the sale, said Berjaya Group.
